column1: app|/æp/|n.|应用程序|四级|technology-computing|a mobile app::手机应用;open an app::打开应用|The app saves your notes on the device.::这个应用把你的笔记保存在设备上。|She uses an app to plan her daily reading.::她用一个应用安排每天的阅读。

blog|/blɑːɡ/|n.; v.|博客；写博客|四级|technology-communication|write a blog::写博客;a travel blog::旅行博客|He writes a blog about life in a small town.::他写博客介绍小镇生活。|The blog includes photographs of local plants.::这个博客包含当地植物的照片。

podcast|/ˈpɑːdkæst/|n.|播客；可下载的音频节目|四级|technology-communication|listen to a podcast::听播客;a weekly podcast::每周更新的播客|I listen to a podcast while walking to work.::我步行上班时听播客。|The weekly podcast explains a different scientific idea each time.::这个每周更新的播客每次讲解一个不同的科学概念。

smartphone|/ˈsmɑːrtfoʊn/|n.|智能手机|四级|technology-devices|use a smartphone::使用智能手机;a smartphone camera::智能手机摄像头|Her smartphone can display the map without a network connection.::她的智能手机没有网络连接也能显示地图。|We used a smartphone camera to record the experiment.::我们用智能手机摄像头记录了实验。
swipe|/swaɪp/|v.; n.|滑动；刷卡；快速挥击|四级|digital-navigation|swipe left::向左滑动;swipe a card::刷卡|Swipe left to see the next photograph.::向左滑动以查看下一张照片。|Please swipe your card at the entrance.::请在入口处刷卡。

website|/ˈwebsaɪt/|n.|网站|基础|technology-communication|visit a website::访问网站;an official website::官方网站|The website lists the opening times of the museum.::这个网站列出了博物馆的开放时间。|Check the official website before you travel.::出行前请查看官方网站。

browse|/braʊz/|v.|浏览；随意翻阅|四级|browse|browse the web::浏览网页;browse through::随意翻看|You can browse the collection without creating an account.::你无需创建账户就可以浏览馆藏。|She likes to browse through old travel books.::她喜欢随意翻阅旧旅行书。
browser|/ˈbraʊzər/|n.|浏览器；浏览者|四级|browse|a web browser::网页浏览器;open a browser::打开浏览器|Open a browser and enter the address.::打开浏览器并输入地址。|The browser remembers the pages you visited.::这个浏览器会记住你访问过的网页。

database|/ˈdeɪtəbeɪs/|n.|数据库|基础|digital-files|search a database::检索数据库;an online database::在线数据库|The database contains records of local weather.::这个数据库保存着当地的天气记录。|We search the database by name or date.::我们按姓名或日期检索数据库。

download|/ˈdaʊnloʊd/|n.; v.|下载；下载的文件或内容|基础|digital-files|a free download::免费下载的内容;a large download::较大的下载文件|The guide is available as a free download.::这份指南可以免费下载。|The download includes all the maps for the trip.::下载内容包括此次旅行所需的全部地图。

upload|/ˌʌpˈloʊd/|v.|上传|四级|digital-files|upload a file::上传文件;upload to::上传至|Please upload the completed form before Friday.::请在周五之前上传填好的表格。|She uploaded the photographs to the shared library.::她把照片上传到了共享图库。

update|/ʌpˈdeɪt/|v.|更新；向……提供最新情况|四级|digital-files|update a record::更新记录;update someone on::向某人提供……的最新情况|We update the timetable whenever a class changes.::课程有变动时，我们就更新课表。|Please update the team on your progress tomorrow.::请明天向团队介绍你的最新进展。

backup|/ˈbækʌp/|n.; adj.|备份；后备的；备用的|四级|digital-files|make a backup::制作备份;a backup copy::备份副本|Make a backup before you change the original file.::修改原文件之前，请先备份。|We keep a backup copy on another device.::我们在另一台设备上保存一份备份副本。

button|/ˈbʌtən/|n.|按钮；纽扣|基础|digital-navigation|press a button::按按钮;a shirt button::衬衫纽扣|Press the green button to save your work.::按绿色按钮保存你的工作。|A button fell off his coat during the walk.::散步时，他外套上的一颗纽扣掉了。

click|/klɪk/|v.; n.|点击；发出咔嗒声；咔嗒声|基础|digital-navigation|click on::点击;at the click of a button::按一下按钮即可|Click on a word to see its meaning.::点击一个单词即可查看其含义。|The door closed with a quiet click.::门轻轻咔嗒一声关上了。
delete|/dɪˈliːt/|v.|删除|基础|digital-files|delete a file::删除文件;delete from::从……中删除|Please delete the empty rows from the table.::请删除表格中的空行。|She deleted the old address from her notes.::她从笔记中删除了旧地址。

file|/faɪl/|n.; v.|文件；档案；归档；提交|基础|digital-files|open a file::打开文件;file a report::提交报告|Save the file before you close the program.::关闭程序之前，请保存文件。|The officer must file a report after the inspection.::检查结束后，这名工作人员必须提交报告。

online|/ˌɑːnˈlaɪn/|adj.; adv.|在线的；在网上|四级|technology-communication|an online course::在线课程;go online::上网|The online course includes short lessons and reading lists.::这门在线课程包含简短的课程和阅读书目。|The library lets readers renew books online.::图书馆允许读者在网上续借图书。

password|/ˈpæswɜːrd/|n.|密码；口令|四级|digital-navigation|enter a password::输入密码;change a password::修改密码|You need a password to open the shared folder.::打开这个共享文件夹需要密码。|She changed her password after replacing her phone.::她更换手机后修改了密码。

keyboard|/ˈkiːbɔːrd/|n.|键盘；键盘乐器|基础|technology-devices|a computer keyboard::电脑键盘;use a keyboard::使用键盘|The keyboard has a separate key for each letter.::这个键盘为每个字母设有独立的按键。|He used a small keyboard to write the message.::他用一个小键盘写下了这条消息。

mouse|/maʊs/|n.|鼠标；老鼠|基础|technology-devices|a wireless mouse::无线鼠标;move the mouse::移动鼠标|Move the mouse to place the pointer over the word.::移动鼠标，把指针放在单词上方。|A small mouse ran behind the cupboard.::一只小老鼠跑到了橱柜后面。

laptop|/ˈlæptɑːp/|n.|笔记本电脑|四级|technology-devices|a laptop computer::笔记本电脑;charge a laptop::给笔记本电脑充电|She carries a light laptop to every class.::她每次上课都带着一台轻便的笔记本电脑。|My laptop can work for several hours without charging.::我的笔记本电脑不充电也能工作数小时。

desktop|/ˈdesktɑːp/|n.; adj.|台式电脑；桌面；台式的|四级|technology-devices|a desktop computer::台式电脑;the desktop screen::桌面画面|The office provides a desktop computer for each employee.::办公室为每位员工提供一台台式电脑。|A copy of the file appeared on the desktop.::文件的一份副本出现在桌面上。

link|/lɪŋk/|n.; v.|链接；联系；连接|基础|digital-navigation|follow a link::打开链接;a link between::……之间的联系|Follow the link to read the full report.::打开链接即可阅读完整报告。|The study found a link between sleep and memory.::这项研究发现了睡眠与记忆之间的联系。

search|/sɜːrtʃ/|v.; n.|搜索；搜查；寻找|基础|digital-navigation|search for::寻找;in search of::为了寻找|We searched for the missing file by its name.::我们通过文件名寻找丢失的文件。|The travelers went inland in search of fresh water.::旅行者为寻找淡水而走向内陆。

forum|/ˈfɔːrəm/|n.|论坛；讨论会；交流场所|四级|technology-communication|an online forum::网络论坛;a public forum::公共讨论会|The forum gives new students a place to ask questions.::这个论坛为新生提供了提问的地方。|Residents shared their views at a public forum.::居民们在一场公共讨论会上分享了看法。

chat|/tʃæt/|v.; n.|闲聊；聊天|基础|technology-communication|chat with::与……聊天;have a chat::聊一聊|We often chat with our neighbors after dinner.::晚饭后，我们常和邻居聊天。|She stayed for a short chat before catching the bus.::她在赶公交车之前留下来聊了一小会儿。

email|/ˈiːmeɪl/|n.; v.|电子邮件；给……发电子邮件|基础|technology-communication|send an email::发送电子邮件;email someone::给某人发电子邮件|Please send an email if your plans change.::如果你的计划有变，请发一封电子邮件。|I will email the final timetable to everyone tonight.::今晚我会把最终课表通过电子邮件发给所有人。

text|/tekst/|n.; v.|文本；正文；短信；发短信|基础|technology-communication|the original text::原文;send a text::发短信|The original text is printed beside the translation.::原文印在译文旁边。|Send me a text when you arrive at the station.::你到车站时给我发条短信。

wireless|/ˈwaɪərləs/|adj.|无线的|四级|technology-communication|a wireless connection::无线连接;a wireless device::无线设备|The library offers a wireless connection for visitors.::图书馆为访客提供无线网络连接。|The wireless device sends a signal every minute.::这个无线设备每分钟发送一次信号。
